ONCOGLOBAL PHYSICIAN VISIT BEST PRACTICES
PRE-VISIT PREPARATION: 1. Review physician profile: specialty, prescribing history, last visit outcome, engagement score 2. Check territory manager notes for any pending commitments (literature, samples promised) 3. Identify the visit objective: awareness, trial conversion, loyalty, objection handling 4. Prepare 1 key clinical data point — one sharp fact is better than 10 average ones
VISIT STRUCTURE (5-step): 1. OPENER (30 sec): Greet, reference last visit, state today's purpose - "Dr. Sharma, last time we discussed PD-L1 testing. Today I wanted to share KEYNOTE-024 data on 1st line outcomes." 2. EXPLORATION (1-2 min): Ask about patient types, challenges, competitor usage - "What proportion of your NSCLC patients are you testing for PD-L1 upfront?" 3. PRESENTATION (2-3 min): One product, one key message, one data point 4. OBJECTION HANDLING: Listen fully before responding. Acknowledge, then data. - "Biosimilar pricing concern" → "Herceptin originator data on cardiac safety is more established." 5. CLOSE (30 sec): Specific ask — prescription, test request, CME interest - "Would you consider Tagrisso for your next EGFR-mutated NSCLC patient?"
DOCUMENTATION (right after visit): - Outcome: Positive / Negative / Neutral / Follow-Up Required - What drug was discussed, physician response, any commitments made - Next best action — be specific about date and action
ENGAGEMENT SCORE GUIDE: - 90-100: Physician enthusiastic, committed to prescribe - 70-89: Positive, interested, may prescribe soon - 50-69: Neutral, needs more visits/data - 30-49: Hesitant, has objections to address - Below 30: Negative or hostile — escalate to manager

PHYSICIAN VISIT — Sahi Tarika (Rep Guide)
VISIT SE PEHLE: - Doctor ki profile dekho: pehle kab milna hua, kya discuss hua, engagement score kya tha - Jo promise kiya tha (literature, samples) — woh lekar jao - Aaj ka objective decide karo: naya product introduce karna hai, conversion chahiye, ya follow-up hai? - EK strong data point prepare karo — zyada nahi, ek sharp fact enough hai
VISIT KA STRUCTURE: 1. SHURUAT (30 second): "Dr. saab, pichli baar PD-L1 testing ke baare mein baat ki thi. Aaj KEYNOTE-024 ka data laaya hoon." 2. SAWAL PUCHO: "Aapke kitne lung cancer patients mein EGFR test ho raha hai upfront?" 3. PRODUCT DETAIL (2-3 min): Ek drug, ek key message, ek data point — zyada mat bolo 4. OBJECTION HANDLE KARO: - "Pricing zyada hai" → "Sir, originator data pe cardiac safety better documented hai." - "Mujhe pehle se trusted brand hai" → "Bilkul sir, yahi toh Tagrisso ka benefit hai — established FLAURA data." 5. ASK KARO (specific): "Aapka agla EGFR+ NSCLC patient ho toh Tagrisso consider karenge?"
VISIT KE TURANT BAAD LOG KARO: - Outcome: Positive / Negative / Neutral / Follow-Up Required - Kya discuss hua, doctor ki response kya thi - Agla step kya hai — specific date aur action likhna
ENGAGEMENT SCORE GUIDE: - 90-100: Doctor bahut enthusiastic, confirm karenge - 70-89: Positive, interested, soon prescribe karenge - 50-69: Neutral, aur data chahiye, dobara jaana hoga - 30-49: Hesitant, objections hain, handle karna hai - 30 se kam: Negative — manager ko batao
